blocks.label: Overview
bullets: For Use in Bread Machines & Traditional Baking
paragraphs: Active dry yeast provides a moderate and steady leavening rate to develop more flavor in all types of yeast doughs from low sugar to highly sweetened and enriched. The All-Natural Active Dry Yeast is pure yeast with no added ingredients.

blocks.label: Suggested use
paragraphs: Baking Tips: Use a thermometer to determine liquid temperatures. For traditional baking methods: Dissolve one packet in 1/4 cup warm liquid, 110°- 115°F. Add 1/2 tsp sugar. Wait for foam to double in volume. Or Blend yeast with dry ingredients. Add very warm liquids, 120°-130°F. Avoid liquid temperatures above 140° F as this will harm the yeast. For bread machines: Use liquids at 80°F.
Approximately 2 1/4 tsp. equals one 1/4 oz. packet of Red Star® Yeast. Three 1/4 oz. packets equal the activity of one 2 oz. yeast cake.

blocks.label: Other ingredients
paragraphs: Does not contain wheat gluten or other cereal protein.

blocks.label: Warnings
paragraphs: Store in a cool, dry place.
Do not eat raw yeast-raised dough.
